THE_DEFECT_verified_first_hand.statement: The context trimmer is billed for text the model is never shown, and evicts real content to pay for it.
THE_DEFECT_verified_first_hand.half_one_already_known: tool_agent.py:2267 stores thinking as assistant_message['reasoning']; chat_template.jinja reads message.reasoning_content and renders '' when absent. Proven with jinja2 against the real template in generated/reasoning-carry-defect-2026-08-27.json. Arm rcarry repaired this for the newest 2 turns and is in the daily rotation.
THE_DEFECT_verified_first_hand.half_two_which_is_THIS_ARM: _estimate_request_input_tokens (tool_agent.py:1959) does json.dumps({'messages': messages}) over the WHOLE message dicts, and _estimate_tokens (618) charges (len+2)//3. Verified by reading both functions. So every retained assistant turn is billed for its `reasoning` at full length while showing the model nothing.
THE_DEFECT_verified_first_hand.the_scale_measured_by_me_today: Across 1,305 real analyzer turns from a 25-game run, mean section sizes are: SYSTEM PROMPT 13,189 chars, THINKING 5,249, USER PROMPT 3,067, ASSISTANT 1,553, MODEL RESPONSE META 960, ANALYZER STATUS 430. THINKING is 1,750 estimated tokens against 2,003 for everything else in a turn, so 47% of a retained turn's estimated cost is phantom.
THE_DEFECT_verified_first_hand.the_consequence_measured_today: The trimmer fires on 24.7% of turn transitions and destroys a median of 9 messages each time, 2,837 per 25-game run (solution/analysis/history_eviction_rate.py).

what_the_arm_does: One method plus one call line in tool_agent.py. Before the trimmer estimates, drop `reasoning` from assistant messages outside the reasoning-carry window. Messages are COPIED. ZERO tokens are added; tokens are only stopped from being spent. Overlay solution/kaggle/anim_overlay/apply_phantom_strip.py, bundle vineethsaivs/arc3-q38-phantom-v1, kernel vineethsaivs/arc3-ps-phantom-strip-a.

measured_effect_on_the_estimate_before_a.method: the SHIPPED _estimate_tokens, run on synthetic histories built from the measured section means

why_it_is_not_arm_AB: AB carried a model-authored generalisation ACROSS a level reset, feeding the model stale beliefs, and lost 55 levels against 76. This arm carries nothing and creates nothing. It only deletes, and only text the model provably never reads.
why_it_cannot_be_inert: There is nothing to read. Advisory prose measures inert on Qwen-27B (predict() called 0 times in 25 games; the summarized-knowledge block populated on 0.8% of turns). This ships zero characters.

WHAT_THIS_RESULT_WOULD_KILL_BEYOND_THE_A: If the counters fire, the eviction rate falls, retained turns rise about 40%, and levels come back <= 29, then 'the budget is spent on phantoms and that is why we die' is FALSE, and COMPACTION dies with it: if handing the model 40% more real history costs levels, summarising the deleted part cannot help either. Record that and stop spending GPU on the trimmer.
